name: haiku
description: Project-local Codex bridge for the Haiku Method, initialized for this repository's software studio workflow.

interface.shortDescription: Use Haiku's studio and stage model from Codex in this repo
interface.longDescription: Repo-local Codex bridge for the Haiku Method. It initializes `.haiku/` project settings and exposes a Codex-native `$haiku` skill for start, pickup, refine, operate, and reflect flows without relying on Claude-only `/haiku:*` commands.
defaultPrompt: Use $haiku to start the next feature for this repo.
Use $haiku to pick up the current active intent.
Use $haiku to reflect on the last completed intent.
